annotations.title: Best offers delivered to Italy, with a certain total

description: Use this when the user asks where to buy an item or what it really costs delivered to Italy. Returns up to the 3 cheapest offers from real shops whose delivered total is CERTAIN (shipping, import duty, EU handling fee and VAT all known), each with a Crossave link to the offer, plus the link to all offers. Read-only, from the comparison Crossave already prepared: if none is ready it says so and gives the link to run it. Show the card; do not add estimates.

prodotto.description: The item, in the shopper's words, e.g. "Charizard ex 199/165".
